witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W1 plant supply limits (outflow <= supply); W2 edge capacities; W3 TRUE flow conservation at hub H with correct edge orientation; W4 demand met exactly at D1,D2; W5 reported objective equals recomputed production+transport cost with TRUE costs (tol 1e-6).

c2_dir.description: C2 direction error: outflow edge H->D2 written on the inflow side of hub conservation (sign reversal). Type-legal, feasible when d1>d2; optimal supply no longer matches true total demand -> true conservation violated.

c1_bind.description: C1 binding error: objective charges edge B->H at edge A->H's unit cost. Constraints untouched; reported objective mismatches recomputed true cost -> W5.
